about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-hsg141 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Paragraphs 6, 7 and 8 are not sections of their own; their text and numbers are run into the last bullet of paragraph 5.
findings.evidence: source: "6 This guidance does not cover the specification or use of electrical equipment" / tree: "structures about to be demolished. 6 This guidance does not cover"

findings.problem: The year 1998 lost its last digit twice in paragraph 3, and two stray 8s were put at the end.
findings.evidence: source: "Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998 (PUWER 1998)." / tree: "Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 199 (PUWER 199 ). 8 8"
